newsitem.title: CANADA: Brymore Energy to announce sale to UtiliCorp.
newsitem.headline: Brymore Energy to announce sale to UtiliCorp.

text.p: Brymore Energy Ltd, a private Canadian natural gas marketer, was expected to announce as early as today that it was acquired by UtiliCorp Energy Services Ltd, a unit of Kansas City-based UtiliCorp United Inc.
In a letter to business associates, Brymore said the effective date of the transaction, the value of which was not disclosed, would be November 1.
A staff member at Brymore's Calgary office confirmed the letter was genuine.
UtiliCorp United owns energy marketer Aquila Energy Corp, which recently opened a Calgary-based trading unit.
It is also affiliated in Canada with UtiliCorp British Columbia, which owns electrical utility West Kootenay Power.
